notes.title: Fourth Anniversary Patch (28/9/2022)
notes.notes:
As is a somewhat coincidental tradition, here is a yearly collection of fixes and QOL improvements:


 Implemented a fix that should stabilize performance and framerate on Windows 10. Big thanks for the heads-up in our Steam Community Bug Megathread!
 Fixed a bug where a rounding mistake was able to decimate an entire high score table. Sorry about that 💦
 Revised [ROCKET TECH] input & timing. Now requires full tilt on analog stick, but can also be suppressed by holding SLOW.
 Added settings for fine tuning analog stick sensitivity. (If you were attached to how the analog stick felt in the previous version, the values were 30% for deadzone & 60% for full speed!)
 Game now pauses when a gamepad in use disconnects.
 Paintjob

That's all fine and dandy, but surely you can share some info about Black Onion?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32258001/b96ec39d3d8b41e53171a382436a805cbed29330.png

Until next time!

notes.title: Third Anniversary Update: Steam Cloud and more! (28/09/2021)
notes.notes:
It's the third anniversary of ZeroRanger's release! For the occasion, we've prepared an update with new features, small QoL improvements and bugfixes:

FEATURES:

 Steam Cloud saves!! Your save files and scores can now transfer between different machines. (NOTE!: if you purposefully had different saves on different machines, turn off Steam Cloud if you wish to retain them!)
 Lock-on buff?! Previously an all-offensive tool, Lock-on has gained some defensive properties! Upon releasing a group of locked-on lasers, a bullet-cancelling shockwave is emitted. How this shockwave works exactly depends on the ship.
 3-button combination input leniency: It can now be activated regardless of when each button was pressed, as long as all of them are eventually held down together. The old, stricter input method can be selected from OPTIONS -> CONTROLS if preferred.
 Added FPS display option to VISUALS menu. (Previously only available through pressing F2)
 Revamped CONTROLS menu a bit for better clarity.
 A bunch of visual flair and clarifications.
 Masher's Curse

BUGFIXES:

 Executable no longer needs to extract itself: Resolves some cases of the game not running due to machine permissions stopping either the extraction process or the extracted files.
 GREEN ORANGE co-op life gain was simultaneously broken in two different ways that somehow cancelled each other out and it kind of worked...? Fixed that (both of them)
 Stage 4 SE-bonuses can no longer be collected too early so that they disappear from the SE-bonus tally.
 A bunch of small, yet not exactly innocent bugs
As always, your bug reports are being heard, so keep 'em coming if you run into any problems!


Fly high!!

notes.title: Second Anniversary Update (28/09/2020)
notes.notes:
ZeroRanger turns two! Mostly and completely coincidentally, it also gets an update:

FEATURES:

Your score now gets recorded when facing [????]
A special trial now opens for those who have reached LIGHT...

BUGFIXES:

Game now properly recognizes your old version's settings file (SETUP.zr / SETUP2.zr) if you don't have the July 2020 version's settings file (SETUP2-2.zr) around.
Fixed some inconsistencies in recognizing achieved challenges
Fixed WHITE VANILLA grades spilling over to GREEN ORANGE in the RESULTS
Fixed some crashes... But there are still some known ones. Your bug reports are being heard, so keep 'em coming!


For endless light!

notes.title: Gamepad update (22/12/2018)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32258001/6dd53892ff2b8245ce821671b29f04a17c5c6961.png
Much anticipated controller update is finally here, with quite a few improvements.

GAMEPAD OVERHAUL:

  Gamepad button remapping supported
  Both XInput and DirectInput gamepads supported
  The typo that killed player 2 gamepad entirely is fixed - sorry about that!
  Additional & optional settings: Analog/digital movement, slow button, 3rd weapon autofire


MISCELLANEOUS:

Some bugs gone (stingy score salamander, floor prison)
Some crashes gone (being shy about your team name in co-op)
Probably some others too but it's been a while since the last patch


A little bird told us someone wished for a season-appropriate palette, so GREEN+RED has been added! And since it's the worst possible palette regarding colorblindness, we threw in another icy & spicy palette too.

We've also created a new bug megathread in order to more easily catalog any possible bugs/errors that might surface, so feel free to report them there.

This will be our final update for this year (unless something urgent shows up). We're pretty pumped to see what the next year has in store for us - let's make it even better than the last one.

Happy holidays everyone!

-System Erasure

notes.title: New patch out (2/10/2018)
notes.notes:
A new patch for ZeroRanger is now out with a handful of fixes and improvements:

Fixed controls locking up during certain transitions
Fixed some music playback & Sound test inconsistencies
Fixed some crashes
Removed an [unfriendly oversight]


New updates are still coming, so if you happen to have any suggestions or problems you would like see addressed, keep them coming! We may not be able to respond to everyone but we do still read and listen all feedback as we sort out our next plan of attack.

But before that, we're going to need a moment of rest... Thank you for your support so far, everyone!
-System Erasure

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW + Release Date Update
notes.notes:
ZeroRanger DEMO Version is now available for download.

This demo offers a short, vertical slice of the final game.
There are some surprises left for those who're already familiar with the game's previous iterations.

We hope you'll enjoy your time with the demo. Feel free to send us feedback - there's still some work left before the game is ready for release after all.

Speaking of which, we now also have a concrete launch date on our sights: August 24th 2018!
After all these years it feels almost surreal... We're doing our best in order to finish strong.

Take care!
-System Erasure

notes.title: NAME UPDATE + ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32258001/bab39ef0702b2c18ba1a35aee0ba1e47a7bcd097.png

FINALBOSS has been renamed to ZeroRanger.

Although we were rather attached to the old title (it has been around for quite a while), we ultimately came to a decision that a new, more distinct name would go a long way in helping with the game's recognizability in the future.

One more thing...

We're currently finalizing a brand new DEMO version based on the game's latest build. This demo will be publicly available in just a few days!


That's all for now. Take care!
-System Erasure
